proposals.before: On yichou day, in accordance with the testamentary edict, the late emperor's younger half-brother Zhimu was called before the Zaitu Hall and restored as Prince of Ning.
proposals.after: On yichou day, in accordance with the testamentary edict, the late emperor's elder half-brother Zhimu was called before the Zaitu Hall and restored as Prince of Ning.
proposals.reason: 庶兄 means elder half-brother (兄), not younger half-brother.

proposals.before: On jiawu day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Derang reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had raided the frontier; troops were dispatched and routed them.
proposals.after: On jiashen day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had raided the frontier; troops were dispatched and routed them.
proposals.reason: Chinese 甲申 is jiashen, not jiawu; 韓德威 is Han Dewei, not Han Derang.

proposals.before: On jiawu day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Derang reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had invaded the border; troops were sent and defeated them.
proposals.after: On jiashen day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had invaded the border; troops were sent and defeated them.
proposals.reason: Matches Chinese day-cycle 甲申 and personal name 韓德威.

proposals.before: The Southwest Route pacification commissioner reported that Tangut chieftains including the son of yilijin Zuiyin were begging to submit; an edict ordered them received and settled, but also to test their sincerity and maintain strict border defenses.
proposals.after: The Southwest Route pacification commissioner reported that Tangut chieftains had seized the yilijin's son Weiyin and others and were begging to submit; an edict ordered them received and settled, but also to test their sincerity and maintain strict border defenses.
proposals.reason: 執 is the verb 'seize', not part of the name Zuiyin; 隈引 is Weiyin.

proposals.before: On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was estranged from the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was sent out as Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
proposals.after: On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was estranged from the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was sent out as Xingguo Army military commissioner.
proposals.reason: Chinese 興國軍 is Xingguo Army, not Liaoxing Army.

proposals.before: On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was at odds with the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was then sent out as Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
proposals.after: On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was at odds with the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was then sent out as Xingguo Army military commissioner.
proposals.reason: Chinese 興國軍 is Xingguo Army, not Liaoxing Army.

proposals.before: On bingzi day Han Derang sent xiangwen zhamas to defeat the Tangut and reported the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
proposals.after: On bingzi day Han Dewei sent xiangwen zhamas to defeat the Tangut and reported the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
proposals.reason: 韓德威 is Han Dewei, not Han Derang.

proposals.before: On bingzi day Han Derang sent xiangwen zhamas to break the Tangut and sent the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
proposals.after: On bingzi day Han Dewei sent xiangwen zhamas to break the Tangut and sent the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
proposals.reason: 韓德威 is Han Dewei, not Han Derang.

proposals.before: On renzi day Han Derang memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; the court approved;
proposals.after: On renzi day Han Dewei memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; the court approved;
proposals.reason: 韓德威 is Han Dewei, not Han Derang.

proposals.before: On renzi day Han Derang memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; an edict approved it;
proposals.after: On renzi day Han Dewei memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; an edict approved it;
proposals.reason: 韓德威 is Han Dewei, not Han Derang.

proposals.before: On maoyin day in the third month the Huali division petitioned that xiangwen posts should henceforth be filled only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "Officials among the tribes must be chosen for ability — how can appointments be fixed by tribal limits alone."
proposals.after: On yimao day in the third month the Huali division petitioned that xiangwen posts should henceforth be filled only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "Officials among the tribes must be chosen for ability — how can appointments be fixed by tribal limits alone."
proposals.reason: 乙卯 is yimao, not maoyin.

proposals.before: In the third month, on maoyin day, the Huali division requested that henceforth xiangwen posts be appointed only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "For officials among the divisions, what matters is getting the right men — how can appointment be fixed by division alone."
proposals.after: In the third month, on yimao day, the Huali division requested that henceforth xiangwen posts be appointed only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "For officials among the divisions, what matters is getting the right men — how can appointment be fixed by division alone."
proposals.reason: 乙卯 is yimao, not maoyin.

proposals.before: On maoyin day in the fifth month the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
proposals.after: On yimao day in the fifth month the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

proposals.before: In the fifth month, on maoyin day, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
proposals.after: In the fifth month, on yimao day, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
proposals.reason: 乙卯 is yimao, not maoyin.

proposals.before: On xinchou day in the twelfth month Hanlin academician director Ma Dechen was appointed Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yao promoted to Great Inner tithen, and Darenjing Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.
proposals.after: On xinchou day in the twelfth month Hanlin academician director Ma Dechen was appointed Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yaosheng Great Inner tihu, and Darenjing Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.
proposals.reason: 耶律瑤升 is the personal name Yelü Yaosheng, not Yelü Yao 'promoted'; parallel appointment list omits 為 after the first.

proposals.before: In the twelfth month, on xinchou day, Hanlin Academician Director Ma Dechen was made Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode was made Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yao was promoted to Great Inner tithen, and Darenjing was made Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.
proposals.after: In the twelfth month, on xinchou day, Hanlin Academician Director Ma Dechen was made Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode was made Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yaosheng was made Great Inner tihu, and Darenjing was made Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.
proposals.reason: 耶律瑤升 is one name; 升 is not the verb 'promoted' here.

proposals.before: On wuyin day Princess Hugudian was granted gold, silk, artisans, and other goods for her husband's burial.
proposals.after: On wuyin day Princess Hugudian was granted gold, silk, and artisans for her husband's burial.
proposals.reason: Chinese 金帛、工匠 lists only gold/silk and artisans; “and other goods” is not in the source.

proposals.before: On wuyin day, Princess Hugudian was granted gold and silk, artisans, and other goods for her husband's burial.
proposals.after: On wuyin day, Princess Hugudian was granted gold and silk and artisans for her husband's burial.
proposals.reason: Chinese 金帛、工匠 does not include an “other goods” category; remove the invented addition.

proposals.before: On dingchou day an edict ordered Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor Qipodili to reassure the border population.
proposals.after: On dingchou day an edict ordered Podili, wife of the Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor, to reassure the border population.
proposals.reason: Chinese 監軍妻婆底裏 most naturally reads as the supervisor’s wife 婆底裏; fusing 妻 into the personal name Qipodili obscures the kinship term.

proposals.before: On dingchou day, an edict ordered Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor Qipodili to comfort the border people.
proposals.after: On dingchou day, an edict ordered Podili, wife of the Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor, to comfort the border people.
proposals.reason: Chinese 東北路兵馬監軍妻婆底裏 uses 妻 as “wife” before the name 婆底裏 rather than as part of a fused personal name.

s0138 dates the event 三月乙卯; 乙卯 is yimao, not maoyin.
